extra_vocab.en: the state of meeting the rules to get or do something
extra_vocab.note: 文章開頭說快速退款申請 was not eligible，eligibility 就是它的名詞形，指「有沒有資格申請退款」。在客服信件、保險、福利說明裡很常見。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: eligibility 是不可數名詞，不加 s；後面常接 for + 名詞，或 to + 動詞原形（eligibility to apply）。

example.en: Your eligibility for a refund depends on the purchase date.
example.zh: 您是否有退款資格取決於購買日期。

example.en: The eligibility criteria are listed on our website.
example.zh: 資格標準列在我們的網站上。

example.en: Please check your eligibility before you fill out the form.
example.zh: 填寫表格之前，請先確認您的資格。

example.en: The team will determine eligibility within five business days.
example.zh: 團隊會在五個工作天內判斷是否符合資格。

example.en: We need a valid ID to confirm eligibility for the discount.
example.zh: 我們需要有效證件來確認您有資格享有折扣。

examples.en: We are reviewing your eligibility and will reply by Friday.
examples.zh: 我們正在審核您的資格，會在星期五前回覆。

examples.en: Eligibility for the bonus starts after six months of service.
examples.zh: 獎金資格在到職滿六個月後開始。

examples.en: The company explained the eligibility rules for the new health plan.
examples.zh: 公司說明了新健康保險方案的資格規定。

confusable.diff: legibility 是「（字跡）清楚易讀」；eligibility 是「資格」，兩字字尾相近但意思完全不同。

example.en: The legibility of the handwritten form made it hard to process.
example.zh: 手寫表單字跡不易辨認，讓處理變得困難。

confusable.diff: liability 是「法律責任」；eligibility 是「資格」，字尾都是 -bility，發音節奏也相似。

example.en: The contract limits the company's liability for late delivery.
example.zh: 合約限制了公司對延遲交貨的責任。

similar.diff: qualification 常指個人的條件或證書；eligibility 指是否符合某個項目的規定。

example.en: Her qualifications make her a strong candidate for the job.
example.zh: 她的資歷讓她成為這份工作的強力人選。

similar.diff: entitlement 強調依規定「有權得到」的東西；eligibility 強調「是否符合條件」。

example.en: Every employee has an entitlement to ten days of paid leave.
example.zh: 每位員工都享有十天的帶薪假。

example.en: A valid passport is a requirement for this trip.
example.zh: 有效護照是這趟行程的必備條件。

example.en: We use clear criteria to choose our suppliers.
example.zh: 我們用明確的標準來選擇供應商。

example.en: The refund needs approval from the finance manager.
example.zh: 這筆退款需要財務經理核准。

example.en: You will receive a full refund within ten days.
example.zh: 您將在十天內收到全額退款。

derived.link: 這是詞幹。eligible + -ity，形容詞變抽象名詞，像 able → ability。
in- 表示「不」，像 incorrect、incomplete，加在 eligible 前面變相反。
ineligible + -ity，變成名詞，指「沒有資格這件事」。

extra_vocab.zh: 資格條件、申請資格要求
extra_vocab.en: the rules you must meet to be allowed to get or do something
extra_vocab.note: 這個片語用在退款、補助、保險、報名等情境，說明誰可以申請。文章中的 not eligible 就是「不符合這類資格條件」的意思。
extra_vocab.pattern: meet the eligibility requirements for + N
extra_vocab.grammar_note: requirements 通常用複數；搭配的動詞用 meet 或 satisfy，不說 match。

examples.en: Please read the eligibility requirements before you submit your request.
examples.zh: 提交申請前，請先閱讀資格條件。

examples.en: Your request does not meet the eligibility requirements for a fast refund.
examples.zh: 您的申請不符合快速退款的資格條件。

examples.en: The eligibility requirements for the training program are on the intranet.
examples.zh: 培訓計畫的資格條件登載在公司內部網站上。

examples.en: We may change the eligibility requirements without giving advance notice.
examples.zh: 我們可能在不事先通知的情況下更改資格條件。

similar.diff: criteria 是「判斷標準」，語氣較中性；requirements 強調「必須達到的要求」。

example.en: The eligibility criteria are the same for every applicant.
example.zh: 每位申請人的資格標準都相同。

similar.diff: entry requirements 常指入學、入境或加入活動的門檻；eligibility requirements 範圍更廣，如福利、退款。

example.en: The entry requirements for this course include two years of experience.
example.zh: 這門課的報名條件包括兩年經驗。
